about: Chapter and work-group polls, 2020 on (VAULT-DESIGN §5.6). Hand-written from each space's chat through October 2026; each later month's are added by scripts/plan-votes-gemini.mjs in the monthly run: scripts/build-elections-plan.mjs turns each into a poll in that space. Every poll is one Yes/No question (Voting counts a poll question as yes against no, so a poll offers no other choices); yes is the share of votes cast answering Yes, and fail marks a poll most answered No. A chapter poll goes to the chapter's current members, a work-group poll to the space's members. opens and closes are dates; a poll closes at 23:00 UTC.

polls.name: Benelux & Nordic Chapter poll: spring tastings online
polls.question: Move this spring's chapter tastings online?
polls.text: Travel restrictions rule out the March and April tastings in person. ICF staff can host them as online sessions instead.

polls.name: Oceania Chapter poll: event fee waivers
polls.question: Ask ICF to waive chapter event fees this year for members hit by cancellations?
polls.text: Several creameries lost their spring market and event income. The chapter would ask ICF to waive its event fees for them until December.

polls.name: British Isles Chapter poll: in-person spring tasting
polls.question: Hold the 2022 spring tasting in person?
polls.text: If the venue allows, the 2022 spring tasting would return to an in-person format, with recordings for members who cannot travel.

polls.name: California Chapter poll: hybrid winter meet-up
polls.question: Hold the winter meet-up as a hybrid event, in person with an online link?
polls.text: Members have asked whether the winter meet-up will be hybrid or fully online. A hybrid event needs a venue with a reliable connection and two volunteers to run the stream.

polls.name: France Chapter poll: winter meeting in Poligny
polls.question: Hold a hybrid winter meeting in Poligny rather than staying online until the new year?
polls.text: Production schedules are picking back up. The chapter could meet in Poligny in December with an online link, or stay online until January.

polls.name: Japan Chapter poll: a virtual tasting
polls.question: Try a virtual tasting in December, with samples posted to members?
polls.text: Each member who joins would receive four small samples by post and taste them together on a video call.

polls.name: Canada Chapter poll: a larger venue in Guelph
polls.question: Book a larger venue in Guelph for the autumn workshop series, at a higher fee per seat?
polls.text: The autumn workshops had a waiting list last year. The larger room fits everyone on it but raises the fee per seat by about a fifth.

polls.name: Wisconsin Chapter poll: workshop fees for small makers
polls.question: Keep chapter workshop fees at last year's level for small makers in 2025?
polls.text: Packaging and culture costs are squeezing small makers' margins. Holding the fee flat for them would cost the chapter budget about one workshop's surplus.

polls.name: Italy Chapter poll: autumn meeting agenda
polls.question: Give the autumn chapter meeting over to the raw-milk aging rule updates and traceability?
polls.text: ICF staff can present the updated aging guidelines and the traceability standards if the meeting sets aside its usual member updates.

polls.name: DACH Chapter poll: an online autumn meetup
polls.question: Hold the autumn meetup online instead of in Zurich?
polls.text: An online session would save members the trip; the Zurich meetup keeps the tasting and the cave visit.

polls.name: Pandemic task force poll: workshops by video
polls.question: Move the spring technical workshops to video this season?
polls.text: Apprentices would otherwise lose the season. The workshops would run as recorded modules with live question sessions.

polls.name: Pandemic task force poll: closing the task force
polls.question: Close the task force at year end and hand the online courses to the Education Committee?
polls.text: The online courses run smoothly and the refund backlog is cleared. The final report would go to the board in December.

polls.name: Virtual symposium poll: the platform partner
polls.question: Go with the shortlisted platform partner for the 2021 virtual symposium?
polls.text: The shortlisted platform handles translation feeds and breakout rooms; the alternative is cheaper but has neither. Session mapping can start once the group decides.

polls.name: Chapter events team poll: market day date
polls.question: Hold the Ludlow autumn market day on the first Saturday of October?
polls.text: The fairground can take the first or the third Saturday. The first avoids the harvest festival; the third gives makers more time after summer.

polls.name: Chapter events team poll: spring gathering in Sassari
polls.question: Hold the spring gathering at the Sassari venue?
polls.text: The Sassari venue holds forty people if the date is confirmed by next month. The alternative is a smaller room near Bra.

polls.name: Young cheesemakers poll: sharing cave space
polls.question: Share cave space in Petaluma among cohort members this winter?
polls.text: One member has spare racks in Petaluma. Sharing them would mean a common humidity log and a rota for turning wheels.

polls.name: Hardship dues working group poll: Tier Two reduction
polls.question: Raise the Tier Two dues reduction for the rest of the program?
polls.text: Tier Two cases are taking longer to recover than the guidelines assumed. A larger reduction would use most of the program's remaining budget.

polls.name: Chapter events team poll: pavilion fees
polls.question: Keep pavilion fees flat for smaller makers at the autumn market?
polls.text: Supply costs are up. Larger stallholders would pay the usual increase; smaller makers would pay last year's fee.

polls.name: Traceability pilot poll: the second press line
polls.question: Extend the pilot to the second press line before the midpoint review?
polls.text: The scanner now reads the date on the second line's case labels. Extending the pilot there gives the midpoint review a month of data from both lines.

polls.name: Farmstead producers poll: documentation review
polls.question: Hold the documentation review as an in-person workshop rather than a call?
polls.text: A workshop means a day away from the farm in June; a call can go ahead next week.
